text:
Alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a bunch of noisy SLO alerts for inference p95 across eu-west and us-west. Trying to chase one customer incident, but Kibana trace IDs show the span, while Loki returns nothing for the same trace_id. Anyone else?
Priya: I saw that. The logs for that request are probably on the edge region collector (eu-west-2) and may have been sampled. Quick check: do you have the trace_id?
Alex: trace_id=4f9c2a7e. Kibana shows spans with that id but when I run a Loki query it comes back empty.
Devon: Loki query you ran? Could be label mismatch: we index request_id differently from trace_id.
Alex: Ran this: ```{app="inference-service"} | json | trace_id="4f9c2a7e"``` — zero hits.
Priya: Try this KQL in Kibana to confirm the log field names: ```trace.id: "4f9c2a7e" OR http.request_id: "4f9c2a7e"``` Kibana returns the span & logs. Looks like the ingestion pipeline writes trace.id but FluentD/FluentBit is not mapping it to the Loki label.
infra-bot: alert: inference-p95-eu-west triggered 1784501234 (linked to trace 4f9c2a7e) :warning:
Morgan: If we can't find logs in Loki, we should avoid escalating until we know it's an indexing/label issue. Suggest we do two things: (1) adjust Loki query to search raw message for the trace id, (2) check the log-forwarder parser for that region.
Priya: Raw search: ```{job="fluentbit-eu-west"} |= "4f9c2a7e"``` returns 6 lines (slow). They have the trace id but no label. So the issue is label extraction on the fluent pipeline.
Devon: That explains correlation gap. We recently deployed a parser change in eu-west that renamed request_id -> req_id for others. Looks like trace.id wasn't included. I'll open a quick PR to add trace.id -> trace_id label mapping.
Alex: While you do that, any way to join spans + logs for this incident? I want to stitch events for customer timeline.
Jyoti: You can pipe Loki results into seq join in Grafana Explore but with missing labels it won't join. Workaround: use the raw match then extract fields in the query: ```{job="fluentbit-eu-west"} |= "4f9c2a7e" | json | line_format "{.timestamp} {.message}"``` then manual timeline. It's noisy but workable.
Morgan: Also, this spike triggered multiple Grafana alerts. We're getting alert fatigue — I recommend we change the alert rule to use rate-based smoothing: p95 over 5m OR if p95 increases by >30% sustained for 10m. That'll reduce transient noise while we fix ingestion.
Devon: Agree. I'll open an alert-tuning ticket. Also note: re-ingesting from S3 for eu-west raw logs is possible if we need full context — cost is small for a one-off.
Alex: Good. Can someone add the action items? Need: (A) patch fluentbit parsing in eu-west to emit trace_id label (Devon), (B) temporary alert smoothing (Morgan), (C) re-ingest S3 for trace 4f9c2a7e if needed (Jyoti), (D) add test in nightly cluster to verify trace labels across regions (Priya).
Priya: Adding tests: will add a quick e2e that emits a trace and verifies kibana+loki link. Targeting tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: deploy: fluentbit-parser-eu-west v1.2.3 -> staged at 1784501300
Devon: Deployed parser fix to staging, monitoring for label propagation.
Alex: After the staging verification, can we roll to prod for eu-west? This customer is on eu-west and is experiencing degraded UX.
Devon: I'll run a prod rollout canary to 10% of nodes then 50% if no regressions. ETA 30m.
Jyoti: If we end up re-ingesting, here's the quick command I use to pull raw logs by shard/time: ```aws s3 cp s3://log-archive/eu-west/2026-03-18/part-0001.gz - | zgrep 4f9c2a7e``` helps find traces quickly.
Morgan: After this, let's add a dashboard panel that shows "label coverage" for trace.id across regions (percent of logs that have the trace_id label). That'll help catch regressions early and guide retention/cost tradeoffs.
Alex: Agreed. Thanks team. Keep updates in thread and ping if you need help with canary or S3 pulls.
Priya: Staging shows the label present now, Loki joins to trace id, and I can see the related logs. Pushing to prod canary.
Devon: Prod canary done, labels present. Grafana dashboard now links span -> logs for sample trace.
Alex: Marking incident as "correlation-mapping" for postmortem, but not a severity-1 since customer impact was limited. We'll run a short runbook to remediate and follow up on alert tuning. :white_check_mark:
